parameters.formDescription: Character-consistent stills via Gemini. Leave shot ids empty to generate only missing PNGs.

parameters.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, json, os, sys
req = json.loads(base64.b64decode("{{ $json.payloadB64 }}").decode("utf-8"))
root = "/home/node/files/films/" + req["slug"]
spath = os.path.join(root, "script.json")
if not os.path.exists(spath):
    print(json.dumps({"ok": False, "error": "no script.json in " + root + " — run the Script stage first"}))
    sys.exit(1)
script = json.load(open(spath))
regen = set(req.get("regen_ids") or [])
chars = {c["id"]: c for c in script.get("characters", [])}
work = []
for scene in script.get("scenes", []):
    for shot in scene.get("shots", []):
        sid = shot["id"]
        if os.path.exists(os.path.join(root, "shots", sid + ".png")) and sid not in regen:
            continue
        blocks = []
        for cid in shot.get("characters", []):
            c = chars.get(cid)
            if c:
                blocks.append({"id": cid, "name": c.get("name", cid), "visual_description": c.get("visual_description", "")})
        work.append({"id": sid, "slug": req["slug"], "image_prompt": shot.get("image_prompt", ""),
                     "style_notes": script.get("style_notes", ""), "character_blocks": blocks})
print(json.dumps({"ok": True, "slug": req["slug"], "shots": work}, ensure_ascii=False))
PY

python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, glob, json, os, sys
req = json.loads(base64.b64decode("{{ $json.promptB64 }}").decode("utf-8"))
root = "/home/node/files/films/" + req["slug"]
refs = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(root, "refs", "ref_*.jpg")))
if not refs:
    print(json.dumps({"ok": False, "error": "no normalized refs in " + root + "/refs — re-run Project Setup"}))
    sys.exit(1)
parts = [{"text": req["prompt"]}]
for p in refs:
    with open(p, "rb") as fh:
        parts.append({"inline_data": {"mime_type": "image/jpeg", "data": base64.b64encode(fh.read()).decode("ascii")}})
body = {
    "contents": [{"role": "user", "parts": parts}],
    "generationConfig": {"responseModalities": ["TEXT", "IMAGE"], "imageConfig": {"aspectRatio": "16:9"}},
}
print(json.dumps({"ok": True, "shotId": req["shotId"], "body": body}, separators=(",", ":")))
